description: This file contains a static helper class for creating default user instances within integration tests for the Users feature. It defines a method to asynchronously create a user with preset data using a fixture to send commands.

classes.name: UserHelpers
classes.description: A static utility class providing helper methods for user-related test setup.

methods.name: CreateDefaultUser
methods.description: Creates and returns a default user asynchronously for testing purposes, using a fixture to send a command with preset user data.
